review_cost.rationale: Approve with nits: gitignore the build outputs, clear the debounce timer, dedupe two small helpers, and add lint/typecheck scripts. Nothing needs rework.

findings.issue: Production build outputs (e.g. app/server/q-BrBSDCN_.js, app/server/entry.node-server.js) live inside app/ with no .gitignore covering them; the repo root .gitignore only excludes /data/ and /.data-cache/.
findings.suggestion: Add app/.gitignore with `dist/`, `server/`, `tmp/` (the standard Qwik starter ignore list) and remove the generated files from version control.

findings.issue: The debounce timer is never cleared when the route unmounts, and the nav callback closes over `d.type`/`d.generation` from render time, so a select change racing an in-flight debounce can navigate with stale filters.
findings.suggestion: Clear the timer with `useCleanup$`/`useOnUnmount$`, and in the timer callback read the current selects (document.getElementById or refs) instead of the captured loader values.

findings.issue: Controlled `value={d.q}` on the search input: a loader resolution for an earlier commit re-renders and can momentarily clobber text typed during the round trip.
findings.suggestion: Skip overwriting the input while it has focus (compare el.value against the incoming q before applying), or debounce against a signal instead of navigating per keystroke.

findings.issue: `TypeInfo`/`GenerationInfo` expose `record: any`, letting raw API JSON leak past the typed boundary into route loaders (routes/index.tsx:24,31).
findings.suggestion: Type the fields actually consumed (pokemon list with slot/pokemon, pokemon_species names) or move the derived maps (species types, generation membership) into data.ts so loaders only see typed shapes.

findings.issue: The English type-name Map is rebuilt identically in three loaders (pokemon, moves/[name]:27-28, types/[name]:14-15), and the latest-English-flavor extraction is duplicated between pokemon and moves pages.
findings.suggestion: Add `typeEnglishNames()` and `latestEnglishFlavor(entries)` helpers to lib/format.ts / lib/data.ts and reuse them.

findings.issue: If a move record is missing (404), the Type cell still renders `<a class="type-badge type-" href="/types/">` with an empty href and a broken class.
findings.suggestion: Render a plain em-dash span when `r.type` is empty instead of the link.

findings.issue: No lint or typecheck script (the starter ships eslint-plugin-qwik), and vite ^5.4 is dated for late 2026.
findings.suggestion: Add `"lint": "qwik lint"`-style scripts with eslint-plugin-qwik and bump Vite to the version range Qwik 1.20 supports.

summary: This is a clean, idiomatic Qwik City app on the current stable release: starter-shaped project layout, all data loading in routeLoader$s with resolveValue-driven heads, URL-driven filter state, and lean lib modules with clear boundaries. The main merge blockers are hygiene, not design: build outputs sit un-ignored inside app/, and the debounced search input has small unmount/race issues plus a couple of duplicated helpers across route loaders. I'd approve after a one-round pass of nits.
